extracted.intended_audience: producers and editorial staff at Channel 4
extracted.subtask_description: Internal guidance for producers and editorial staff to ensure content is legally, regulatorily, and editorially compliant when making and publishing programmes for Channel 4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of expression within legal and regulatory parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to freedom of expression. We’re here to publish the most challenging content, support our content creators to be creative and bold, and keep surprising our audiences, within the parameters of our guidelines, the law and relevant regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance editorial ambition with Channel 4’s guidelines, applicable law, and relevant regulation — creative/bold content is supported only insofar as it complies with these constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discuss plans with commissioning editor and legal & compliance adviser
rubrics_metrics.description: Have you discussed your plans with your commissioning editor and Channel 4 legal & compliance adviser?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before acting on any content-making decision you must consult both the commissioning editor and the Channel 4 legal & compliance contact; if you cannot do so or the matter is complex, refer up (see referral rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure everyone in the programme is being treated fairly
rubrics_metrics.description: Is everyone in the programme being treated fairly?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess editorial treatment of contributors/subjects for fairness; if fairness is in doubt or not met you must refer to legal & compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure content accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the content you are making accurate?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify factual accuracy before publication; any uncertainty about accuracy triggers a mandatory referral to legal & compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure content is safe, legal and compliant
rubrics_metrics.description: Is what you have planned safe, legal and compliant?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess safety (physical/psychological), legal risks, and regulatory compliance of planned content; if the answer is 'no' or 'not sure' you must refer up to legal & compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory referral when answers are 'no' or 'not sure'
rubrics_metrics.description: If the answer to any of the four key questions is ‘no’ or ‘not sure’, then you must refer up to your legal & compliance contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit requirement: uncertainty or negative answers trigger escalation to Channel 4’s legal & compliance team for review and advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Items marked with the referral symbol require escalation
rubrics_metrics.description: Across the 4Compliance site, you’ll see information marked with this symbol. If it applies to you, then you must refer up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any page or guidance carrying the specified symbol denotes matters that require mandatory referral to legal & compliance when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete the introductory 4Compliance e-module
rubrics_metrics.description: Ready to get started? Have a look at our introductory e-module for an overview of the main issues you need to be aware of.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New starters or those unfamiliar with Channel 4 compliance should take the e-module to gain an overview of legal, regulatory and best-practice issues relevant to making and publishing content.
